well.name: The Village Well
well.description: Choked with ash and rubble. Cleared and walled anew, its water will let your flask hold one more draught.
restoredLines: The well runs clear again. Your flask can hold one more draught.

ranks.description: Dig the well deeper and line it with stone: one more draught for your flask.
Bless the deep water with a Warden’s ember: one more draught again.

storehouse.name: The Storehouse
storehouse.description: A collapsed storehouse. Rebuilt, it keeps your stash at every bonfire, not just the village's.
restoredLines: Shelves and sacks, stacked to the rafters. Whatever you leave here, you can reach from any bonfire.

ranks.description: Add a loft and a counter: a hundred more places in the stash, and a peddler with a gambler’s eye has asked for the counter.
A cellar under the floor, warded with a Warden’s ember: a hundred more places in the stash.

palisade.name: The Palisade
palisade.description: The village wall lies in splinters. Raised again, it will keep the blight's creatures from rising near the village.
restoredLines: The palisade stands. Nothing of the blight stirs this close to the village now.

ranks.description: Raise watchtowers on the wall: nothing of the blight stirs within sixty paces.
Set a Warden’s ember in the gate: eighty paces of peace.

lamps.name: The Lamp Posts
lamps.description: Toppled lamp posts along the east road. Set upright and lit, they will hold back the dark.
restoredLines: The lamps burn steady. The road east is lit.

ranks.description: Glass the lanterns and trim the wicks: a wider pool of light.
Feed the lamps a Warden’s ember: they burn wide and never gutter.

smithy.name: The Smithy
smithy.description: The smith's forge lies cold and broken. With a Kindling to relight it, the smith will return and take your weapons further than the old forge could.
restoredLines: SMITH: Forge is hot again. Bring me your blade.
SMITH: I can push it past what the old anvil could. Two more tempers, if you've got the iron.
SMITH: Bring me what you find out there, too. I can reroll a perk, or scrub the blight off a cursed piece.
